transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. How can I help you today?

I... well, my husband wanted me to come in. I wasn't going to, but... something happened that scared me. I've been hearing things. Just... my name being called. I heard it from the hallway at home, and then... once at the warehouse where I work. There was nobody there. But it sounded just as real as if my husband was standing right next to me.
Have you ever seen things or noticed other sensations that others around you don’t seem to see or experience?
No... I don't think so. Just the... just hearing my name like I said. I haven't seen anything that wasn't there. Just that.
Have you noticed any changes in your thinking, speech, or behavior that others might find unusual or hard to follow?

I guess... my husband said something about that. He told me I was talking so fast he couldn't get a word in. I was just talking about... overtime at work, and some craft fairs, family history... stuff like that. 

I don't know, I just... I could feel myself pushing to keep talking. Even when I could see he looked really tired. I'm not sure if that's what you mean.
Have you ever seen something that others around you didn’t see, or experienced any other unusual sensations like something touching you when nothing was there?
I... I think I just answered that. No. I haven't seen anything. And nothing is touching me. It's really just what I said before.
Have you heard any other voices or sounds besides your name being called — like people talking, laughing, or any other noises that others don’t seem to hear?
No... just my name. I haven't heard conversations or... laughing, or anything like that. Just what I told you.

Have you ever had any beliefs or thoughts that others might find unusual or hard to understand — like thinking someone is watching you, sending you messages, or that you have special abilities others don’t?
No... I don't think so. I don't have any special abilities or anything. Nobody is watching me. It's just... no. Nothing like that.
Have you ever heard your name being called when no one was around, other than the times you already mentioned?
No, I... I already told you about the only time it happened. There aren't any other times. Just that.
Since the last time we talked about this, have you heard any sounds, voices, or anything else that others around you didn’t hear?

I... I just told you. It's exactly what I said before. That's what scared me enough to come in here, actually. Hearing my name called from the hallway at home... and then that one time at the warehouse. Nobody was even there. But it sounded as real as... as my husband standing right next to me. That's it. Just that.
Have you noticed that you’ve needed less sleep lately, or that you’re able to get by with much less sleep than usual without feeling tired?

I guess... yeah, for a while. I was only sleeping maybe two or three hours a night. But I wasn't tired. I'd just wake up and... feel ready to go. It just felt like sleeping was wasting time, you know? Time I needed to get my projects done. But... that's it.
Since the times you heard your name called, have you heard any other sounds, voices, or noises that other people around you didn’t hear?
I... I feel like we just went over this. Like I said... it was just my name. From the hallway. And that one time at work. I haven't heard anything else. Just... just what I already told you.

Since the times you heard your name called, have you experienced any other unusual sensory experiences — like things looking or sounding different to you than they do to others, or physical sensations with no clear cause?
No... I haven't noticed anything like that. Everything looks fine. I don't... there's nothing else. Just what I already told you.

Have you ever had any beliefs or thoughts that others might find unusual or hard to understand — like thinking someone is sending you special messages, or that you have a special connection to events or people around you?
No... I don't think so. Nobody is sending me messages. I don't really know what you mean by that, but... no. I just go to work and do my job. I don't have any strange thoughts like that.
Since the times you heard your name being called, have you heard any other distinct sounds, words, or voices that weren’t there?
I thought I just answered this... No. I haven't heard any other words or voices. Just my name, like I already told you. That's all.
Have you ever heard voices that gave you commands or comments, even if just briefly?
No. I don't... nobody is telling me what to do or talking about me. I already told you, there aren't any other voices.

Have you ever had any thoughts or beliefs that other people might find very strange or unusual — like thinking that something is happening that isn’t, or that something is trying to tell you something special?
I feel like you just asked me this. No. I don't have strange thoughts. I don't think anything is trying to tell me anything. I just... no.
Have you ever had any strong beliefs or ideas that other people around you didn’t share or understand, even when there wasn’t clear evidence to support them?
No. I don't know what else to tell you. I just go to work and keep to myself. I don't have ideas like that.
Since the times you heard your name being called, have you noticed any other types of sounds or voices that weren’t actually there, even if they were very brief or subtle?
No. It was... just my name. That's it. I haven't heard anything else.
Have you ever had any strong beliefs or suspicions that something was true, even when others told you there was no proof or evidence for it?
No. I... I really don't. Like I said, I just do my job. I'm not... I don't have suspicions like that.
